howItWorks.headline: How it works
howItWorks.title: Optimized for online teams working with multiple cloud tools
howItWorks.description: A seamless workflow designed to eliminate tab clutter and keep your team aligned from day one.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Set up a dedicated space for your client or project in seconds. Invite your team and keep all your mission-critical resources centralized.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Pin direct access links to your Drive files, Figma boards, or Github repos. Attach quick actions to specific resources so your team always knows what to do.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Access everything your team needs straight from your dashboard. Keep tabs closed, reduce digital clutter, and maintain maximum focus.

spaces.title: Spaces
spaces.description: Dedicated, distraction-free environments where you centralize all the specific tools and tasks your team needs. Instead of hunting through endless tabs, everything is organized in one shared space, ready for your team to collaborate in sync.

quicklinks.title: Quicklinks
quicklinks.description: Connect you and your team directly to your Google Drive folders, Figma designs, Trello boards, or any web resource. No more navigating menus or searching through bookmarks—everything your project needs is pinned and ready.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.description: Tasks in Teamspaces aren't just entries in a list; they are directly linked to your project resources. Assign quick actions to specific Quicklinks, ensuring your team knows exactly what to do and where to do it, keeping momentum high and confusion low.
